notes.title: The Road to Release - What's Coming in 1.0?
notes.notes:
[p]Hi Guys[/p][p][/p][p]I wanted to talk about what's coming in the 1.0 release of Creature Clicker and show people that the game is not abandoned, if anything it's about to become a game that I'm so proud of creating and hopefully people will see the effort I've been putting into the game.
[/p][h1]New Updates:[/h1][h3][u]New Dragon Artwork[/u][/h3][p]All of the dragons have had  a complete artistic rework to match the art style of Creature Clicker, they're also animated to bring them to life.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/e04cc8f7db2cfa75d11b83e91c5d45208432520c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u]Dragon Skills:[/u][/h3][p]Your dragon now has the ability to unlock a right click skill so that you can inflict high damage with a cool down timer, this will be a percentage of your click damage[/p][p][/p][p]You can also increase that damage further with an upgrade and also using our new Pygmy Dragon system can further boost it [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/46fb6caade60a9df3cb49a6fbc331f3f39ab52a9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u]Pygmy Dragons:[/u][/h3][p]Pygmy dragons are procedurally generated dragons that you can unlock once you upgrade your castle, pygmy dragons are made of modular pieces and they are based on rarities which then effect the dragon skill damage, there's a huge chance that your dragon will be completely unique to your playthrough and nobody else, just by the chance of having the same modular parts[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/8abba4fde1739d7dd927e9733ecbf50a4e019f28.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Your Own Castle:[/u][/h2][p]The castle is your base of operations, passed to you by your late uncle and it needs a lot of work. Your job is to upgrade your castle which will unlock new features, upgrades, and enhancements.[/p][p][/p][p]Resources are now in Creature Clicker, they appear just like creatures do and when you break them you will get the resources such as Stone, Timber & Fiber etc, these materials can be used to upgrade your castle. Some materials are more rarer than others.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/7af3c257332a975f17ad37d0ba64da3eccf0627c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Player's Room:[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/3a3072e3406fd419765477768049a66c3957cacc.png"][/img][/p][h3][u]Unlockable Costumes:[/u][/h3][p]Your player avatar now has over 10 costumes that can be unlocked and worn, each costume has passive bonuses that are permanent whether they are worn or not.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Arcade Minigames:[/u][/h3][p]Once you unlock the arcade machine in the players room you will be able to attempt to get high scores which will unlock permanent buffs.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Collectable Card Game:[/u][/h3][p]There are multiple card sets based on the elements of the dragons. Fire Set, Water set & Grass set etc.[/p][p]You find packs to rip as you play the game and your goal is to complete the sets which in turn will unlock bonuses.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Dragon's Chambers:[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/4e31630ba6f5d30867530435ef4e72ce79ceee2d.png"][/img][/p][h3][u]Make it your own.[/u][/h3][p]Once you have purchased a piece of furniture in the dragon's chambers you can choose from 4 - 5 different styles in order to make your dragon comfortable [/p][p][/p][h2][u]Gardens:[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/0c42bf5a3ebbb38f2dac3f8fc1bf2778703c82a8.png"][/img][/p][h3][u]Construction:[/u][/h3][p]You can build structures in the gardens of the castle grounds including a chicken coop, a diary farm and a greenhouse. These structures will provide you with passive resources as you play.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Fast Travel:[/u][/h3][p]There's also a horse and cart that you can purchase and it's a very important tool as this will allow you to travel around the world to whichever biome you decide, this will be required as certain resources will only appear in certain biomes.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Fishing / Aquarium:[/u][/h3][p]There's a big lake near your castle that you can do a spot of idle fishing, there's over 20 types of fish to collect and 5 different rarities of each, plus different sizes of fish so obviously you will want to collect these fish and display them where you can admire them so there's a room in your castle that you can unlock for all your collectables including a large aquarium. so you can see the biggest fish you have and the rarities of each.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Skyship & Submarine:[/u][/h2][p]A big part of the new Creature Clicker update will be the ability to construct new methods of travel such as Skyships & Submarines, you will have to build these vehicles in order to reach new biomes like the Skylands & The Deepest Depths[/p][p][/p][h2][u]New Creatures:[/u][/h2][p][/p][p]This brings me onto the integral part of Creature Clicker, it's creatures. of which the new update will have over 50 new creatures of which we currently have 25 new creatures in the development build, so we have some more to announce.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/3f9c896e9c7a07e763d194a1b26319cbf47a4668.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u]New Biomes:[/u][/h3][p]There's a whole host of new locations to visit including the Shores, The Frostlands, Puppethollow, The Skylands & The Deepest Depths each with it's own creatures, resources and quests.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Quest Creatures:[/u][/h3][p]There are new creatures that spawn in each biome that are not capturable, instead they either provide resources or quest progress. One of the new quests will be to help a village in Bumbleberry Forest rebuild after the Orc aftermath and to do this you will have to travel various biomes and defeat different quest creatures.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/22494ce3ef41e7a7f1934c1f0d734c41b3503237.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26674552/c34df7d44b56533fd7dfb3bab9b5e6e11b0d09f3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][u]Conclusion:[/u][/h3][p]I hope this sheds some light into what's coming and gets you excited about the new features, if you want to support us, please give this post a like, follow the wishlist and i'll be showing you some new stuff over the next few weeks.

Common Creatures:

Uncommon Creatures:
1.5% of your Player DPS as bonus damage per unique creature

Rare Creatures:
3% of your Player DPS as bonus damage per unique creature

notes.title: Creature Clicker - The Revamp Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Guys

It's been a while! i have a big update for you all today

I've totally revamped the UI making it much more accessible and less complicated so that everyone can get started with Creature Clicker

There's quite a lot of changes so i'll go through the list

1: Controller Support

You can now play the entire game with a controller, simply press "start or select" when you're ingame and it will spawn a controller icon that you can play the entire game using, so this means you can play Creature Clicker on your TV if you want and this brings me on to the next feature

2: CO-OP support

With the integration of controller support, you can have 4 controllers connected at once so you can have multiple friends for double, triple or four times the damage!

I would assume this will work with Remote Play Together but i've not had a chance to test that feature yet so any feedback would be much appreciated

3: Creature Menu Revamp

I've totally revamped the UI for the creature menu and now everything is on one page and you can easily click between creatures and see what their individual stats are without having to come in and out of confusing menus

4: Loot Menu Revamp

Using the same concept as the creature menu revamp i have updated the equipment menu, you can click through and see exactly what equipment each creature has, what level it is and what the bonus DPS from the equipment is

5: Equipment Revamp

Equipment from chests has been updated so that it's more fairer to achieve a fully equipped creature. now when you find equipment in a chest, it will level up the piece that you've found to the next stage and also the chance of finding equipment in chests is much, much higher

Also every creature now has equipment so happy hunting!

6: Cookery Update

The construction menu has been changed to enable it to be more useful, now when you purchase upgrades for your farm it will also generate ingredients such as cheese, eggs and fish to craft into meals for your creatures that give temporary bonuses

7: Quality of life improvements

The entire game has had a sound pass and UI revamp to make the experience cleaner and feel more responsive to your inputs

I hope you enjoy this update and as always please let me know if there's any bugs or glitches you come across so i can assess and fix them asap

Thanks for your support

~Lee

notes.title: Creature Clicker - Wasp Nest & Forest Cards Update
notes.notes:
Hi Guys

A new update is now live for Creature Clicker, now if you have a Farm unlocked you will start to attract Wasps to your farm

The default attraction rate is 10% and this can be increased to 40% via wasp sugars which give +10% attraction rate per sugar, wasps are farmed automatically when you are on the main screen and this is how the Nest works

When you are on the main screen of Creature Clicker, you will be automatically attracting Worker Wasps

Every 10 Worker Wasps will merge into one of 4 different hybrid wasps

Fire Wasps = +100 DPS
Ice Wasps = +10 Click Strength
Hex Wasps = +1% Crit Chance (Has a limit)
Toxic Wasps = +50 Crit Damage


There is also the new collectable cards which give you +5 click strength per level

There's 8 cards to collect and each card can be leveled from Bronze, Silver, Platinum so you can have +15 Click Strength per card to a maximum of +120 Click Strength

The cards are farmed in the same way wasps are, by chance drops at random intervals


Other Updates:

Another small addition is the cursors which are available on the profile page, these are currently only accessible through DLC purchases

Thanks for the support guys

I really appreciate it

~Lee

notes.title: Update #2 - An Enchanting Update
notes.notes:
Hey Guys

How you all doing?

Well it's been a crazy weekend, thank you guys again for your support and suggestions. I am here to bring you update #2 which brings enchanting onto the table in Creature Clicker. Enchanting? i hear you say.. well enchanting is a feature that gives the game more interactivity which is what a lot of reviewers were saying that the game lacked and to be fair, they had a point so i have expanded on this.

Enchanting:

Enchanting is a feature that lets you spend some gold on increasing the DPS of a creature, all the way up to a maximum of 250 enchants. You can enchant a stage 1 creature to 100 and then a stage 2 creature to 200 and then finally a fancy stage 3 creature can be enchanted to 250.

This also gives the creature ascension system more reason to be used

How do i enchant?

You will find the enchant button just below the Ascend button on the creature overlay screen, you will also notice that the Ascension button has changed, i switched the sprite for ascension with the enchanting button just because they make more sense that way

[img]http://www.phatphrogstudios.com/cc.png[/img]

I will have more for you in the next few days

Thank you again

PS: if you get a chance, please follow my new company facebook page to keep up to date and get notifications of promos and updates

http://www.facebook.com/phatphrogstudios

~Lee

notes.title: We Are Live!!!!! (Finally!!!)
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!

The day is finally here, it's been such a rocky road getting the game to where it is now. As some of you know i started this project as a hobby alongside my full time job but it's turned into a second job. I've really enjoyed developing this game and i can't wait for you guys to jump in and get started, i'm so excited to see who can become the strongest trainer. please upload your screenshots and videos.

I have also introduced some DLC starter packs to help you guys who want to get a little headstart on the competition, these DLC packs range from the Starter Pack $1, Supporter Pack $1.99 and the Deluxe Pack $2.99. Each of these packs will give you a boost to your DPS, Click Strength and Starting Cash.

This is just the beginning for Creature Clicker and i have a lot planned, coming next i will be adding Treasure Chests that unlock loot for your creatures and these will boost your DPS, Click Strength, Crit Rate and Cash etc;

Thank you to everyone for your support over the past few months, i was hoping to release the game a lot earlier than i have but i would rather add more content and release a little later rather than release it half baked. I would like to give a big super thank you to 3 people who have beta tested the pants off this game and without them it wouldn't be half the game it is today

Thanks to the master of achievements Lylat, Thank you to the very special error reporter SLMEPHI[GER] and my good friend DarkyUK for also reporting bugs and testing the game to its limits.

I hope you enjoy the game and if you have any bug reports, suggestions, ideas or criticisms then please head on over to our forums and make your voice heard

Thanks again

Lee
